answer.reason: Both are fee-earning alternative investment managers, working with investors and capital formation. RMR is a real estate manager (property and asset management, CRE investment manager, private CRE credit). Ridgepost manages private equity, venture and private credit funds in the middle and lower middle market. The business model is similar, and private credit and investor capital raising overlap. The asset class differs, and RMR's property and development management has no match at Ridgepost. So the overlap is partial on product and customers.

end_markets.reason: RMR is in commercial real estate. Ridgepost is in private equity, venture and credit. The overlap is weak, mainly private credit.
